question: A laptop is sold for ₹48,000 after two successive discounts of 20% and 25% on the marked price. Find the original marked price of the laptop.842
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discounts: 20% and 25%

Net price factor = 0.80 × 0.75 = 0.60

So SP = 60% of MP

MP = 48000 ÷ 0.60

**∴ Answer = 80000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = 48000

Discounts = 20% and 25%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − d1) × (1 − d2)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × 0.80 × 0.75

⇒ SP = MP × 0.60

⇒ 48000 = MP × 0.60

⇒ MP = 48000 ÷ 0.60

⇒ MP = 80000

**∴ The correct answer is 80000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net factor = (1 − d1)(1 − d2)

Marked Price

Original price before applying any discount

Quick Trick

Multiply remaining percentages directly (80% × 75%)
